$comment: G10 - SPDX license policy, evaluated by scripts/check-licenses.mjs over the CycloneDX SBOMs of what ships. Permissive licenses only. Anything else - copyleft (GPL/LGPL/AGPL), source-available (SSPL/BSL/Elastic), a license that is not an SPDX id, or no license at all - fails until an entry in `exceptions` records why it is acceptable. Compound SPDX expressions are evaluated properly: `A OR B` passes if either side is allowed, `A AND B` needs both, `X WITH Y` always needs an exception.
